title: elaeagnus multiflora var. hortensis
intro: Elaeagnus multiflora var. hortensis, commonly known as the Russian olive, is a deciduous shrub native to China and other parts of Asia. This plant is valued for its rich nutrient profile, providing various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing, reducing inflammation, and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of Elaeagnus multiflora var. hortensis include its ability to reduce oxidative stress, exhibit immunomodulatory effects, and show potential in treating various diseases, such as cardiovascular and respiratory disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
